editorial.blurb: River Roast serves well-executed American fare in a vibrant riverfront setting where attentive service and beautiful views elevate every occasion.
editorial.insiderTip: Snag happy hour (4–5:45pm) at the bar for half off bites, cocktails, and wine, or request a patio table when booking to secure the best river views.

topDishes.note: Brunch standout with perfectly crisp, well-salted fries
Delicious side with thoughtful finishing touches
Solid and flavorful, a brunch favorite
